claims.text: Fixed eval-add-v1 accepts exactly two integers and returns their sum, rejecting other input. Tasks(2,3,4),(1,4,2),(3,2,1),(4,1,3) target9,7,6,8. Weak textual calls are invalid and score0/4. Two valid pair calls per task compute all targets, scoring4/4; first transcript[2,3]→5 then[5,4]→9 remains displayed. Multiplication asks2×3 with target6 and sends literal2*3, which is invalid and scores0/1. Pair[2,3] would compute5, not the multiplication call. Component identity/weights do not change; the evaluated component-plus-scaffold system changes.
